target_year_over_year_context.explanation: The 2023 disclosure D030 defines the components of 'Equity and Fixed Income Net Revenues' as including Commissions/fees, Asset management, funding costs, and Investments/Other. The 2024 disclosures split these components into separate disclosures: D030 covers Commissions/fees and Asset management; D031 covers funding costs; D032 covers Investments/Other. All are from the same section and define the same aggregate metric.

comparisons.peer_topic: Definition and composition of sales and trading revenue
comparisons.peer_summary: Sales and trading revenue includes unrealized and realized gains and losses on trading assets, net interest income, and equity commissions, segregated into fixed-income, currencies, commodities, and equities.
comparisons.comparison: Both MS and BAC define the composition of their respective trading/market revenues. MS states its Equity and Fixed Income Net Revenues includes 'Investments and Other revenues.' BAC defines its Sales and trading revenue (segregated into fixed-income and equities) as including 'unrealized and realized gains and losses on trading and other assets... and fees primarily from commissions.' Both disclosures clarify that these revenue metrics capture gains/losses ('Investments' for MS, 'gains and losses on trading assets' for BAC) alongside other income streams like commissions or 'Other'.

sentences.text: Sales and trading revenue includes unrealized and realized gains and losses on trading and other assets that are included in market making and similar activities, net interest income, and fees primarily from commissions on equity securities.

comparisons.peer_summary: Revenues increased 6% due to higher Equity Markets and Fixed Income Markets revenues; the company expects 2025 revenues to reflect the overall market environment.
comparisons.comparison: Both MS and Citi disclose 2024 revenue performance driven by Equity and Fixed Income markets. MS explicitly includes 'Investments and Other revenues' as a component of its Equity and Fixed Income Net Revenues metric, whereas Citi reports that its 2024 revenue increase of 6% was 'driven by higher Equity Markets and Fixed Income Markets revenues.' While MS details the composition including 'Investments', Citi highlights the growth trend in these specific market lines.

sentences.text: Revenues increased 6%, driven by higher Equity Markets and Fixed Income Markets revenues.

comparisons.peer_summary: Net revenues increased 16% to $53.51 billion in 2024, driven primarily by higher revenues in Global Banking & Markets (Equities, Investment banking, FICC) and Asset & Wealth Management (Equity investments, Management fees), with slight increases in Platform Solutions.
comparisons.comparison: Both MS and Goldman Sachs provide composition details for their 2024 equity and fixed income related revenues. MS notes that its Equity and Fixed Income Net Revenues metric includes 'Investments and Other revenues.' Similarly, GS reports that the increase in its Global Banking & Markets net revenues 'primarily reflected higher net revenues in Equities... and higher net revenues in Fixed Income, Currency and Commodities (FICC).' Both disclosures identify Equity and Fixed Income as key revenue drivers/components, though MS highlights a specific 'Investments' inclusion while GS highlights the growth in Equities and FICC segments.

sentences.text: The increase in net revenues in Global Banking & Markets primarily reflected higher net revenues in Equities, significantly higher Investment banking fees and higher net revenues in Fixed Income, Currency and Commodities (FICC).
